actions.summary: Board deadlocked on extending the district's approved AI learning platforms from high schools to middle schools, so the expansion failed; AI use stays limited to four teacher-controlled platforms in high school.
actions.notes: One of Arizona's five largest districts. Board member Sadie Shaw: 'students have ample opportunity to self-educate outside of the classroom'. The existing high-school policy predates this vote; date unverified. Enrollment figure is approximate.
